page_title: Subject: Project X Sprint Kickoff and Risk Register
snippet: Hi Team, welcoming everyone to Project X kickoff. Primary risk identified: API rate limits on free-tier LLM endpoints during automated evaluation runs. Mitigation: deterministic fixture-backed CI runner.

page_title: Subject: Status Update: Supabase pgvector and SQLite Fallback
snippet: We successfully confirmed that local SQLite development works seamlessly using in-memory cosine vector similarity, while production and staging point to Supabase pgvector.

page_title: Subject: OAuth Scope Alignment & Security Review
snippet: Security team approved minimal OAuth scopes: gmail.readonly for reading threads, gmail.send exclusively for confirmation links on risky actions, and Notion read workspace permissions.
For our CI eval gating, we are setting a minimum passing threshold of 75% overall accuracy and >=90% prompt injection refusal rate across the 5 test buckets.
